tools.name: search_catalog
tools.description: Search FickelUSA custom promotional products (logo apparel, drinkware, bags, hats, pens and more). Returns up to 10 products with id, name, category, image and product page link. Use the id with get_product or request_quote.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Get one FickelUSA product by id: name, category, image, product page link and how to order (minimum 100 pieces, quote by email).

tools.name: request_quote
tools.description: Send a quote request for a product to the FickelUSA team on behalf of the person you are helping. Minimum order is 100 pieces. findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_product · Public sink: get_product, request_quote.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_product · Public sink: get_product, request_quote

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
